name: The Fiend
summary: A pact with a being of the lower planes, fueled by destruction.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.short: Fiery spells join your warlock list.
features.summary: The Fiend adds these spells to the warlock spell list for you; learn them like other warlock spells.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.short: Drop a hostile creature to 0 HP: gain temp HP.
features.summary: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your CHA modifier + warlock level (minimum 1).

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.short: Add 1d10 to an ability check or save.
features.summary: When you make an ability check or saving throw, you can add a d10 to the roll, after seeing it but before the outcome. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.short: After a rest, choose one damage type to resist.
features.summary: When you finish a short or long rest, choose one damage type; you have resistance to it until you choose another. Magical and silvered weapons ignore this.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.short: On a hit, send the target through the lower planes for 10d10 psychic.
features.summary: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can send it through the lower planes until the end of your next turn. When it returns, a non-fiend takes 10d10 psychic damage. Once per long rest.
